note: Regional project page; satellite nowcasting and H-SAF training are project outputs for the region, with no national service stated to receive or use satellite data.

facts.fact: Meteo-France International's project page says the 2019-2022 PMI turnkey modernisation for INAMET (EUR 60m) includes a satellite data reception system to receive the EUMETCast data flow.
The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Angola among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.
